chapter: New Orleans, Havana and back to New York
title: Working as a gigolo in Havana
summary: In Havana for about four months he did not play but escorted women from cruise boats for money.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: No, I didn't play there. I kind of worked as a gigolo there. I used to -- these women would come in on the -- I met some guys around Sloppy Joe's bar there, and they'd come in on these cruise boats, you know, and you'd take them around and you'd get paid for it.
Well, at the time it was fun, but that's not one of the proudest moments of my life, I'll tell you that.
